decisions.rationale: The fetched full commit is compared to the request; Git archive and validated extraction copy tracked files. This is source and filesystem I/O, not a domain policy or canonical authority decision.

Environment creation and exclusive destination creation are I/O mechanics; the named receipt readiness Specification checks artifact kind, completed status, schema and source commit before any installed run. It does not claim tree integrity.

The explicit workspace selects the current directory or existing workspace-root parameter for each existing CLI. This adapter routing does not infer business semantics; two independent synthetic workspaces and their Git repositories were exercised.

The launcher only forwards to the unchanged supervisor and executor boundary; it grants no additional authority and does not implement ASP. Existing supervisor governance still governs refinement; the deterministic fixture ended review_pending, without a real agent or canonical approval.
